species.name: glass-dewberry
species.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the species lifecycle asset sheet. Input 2 is a STYLE AND VISIBILITY REFERENCE: an in-game rainy farm screenshot. Do not reproduce the scene. Redesign the botanical assets so they have the strong substantial silhouettes and DARK OUTLINES of the other crops in the screenshot.
Primary request: MUCH LARGER LEAVES, FLOWERS AND FRUIT, each outlined with a clear dark colored edge. The previous assets reduce to tiny pale twigs and dots. Make fewer, larger, broad solid shapes that will survive reduction to a 16x32 pixel crop. Keep the species identities and the eight asset roles.
Output ONE genuinely transparent RGBA sheet, portrait 1:2, with EXACTLY 8 isolated assets arranged in exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows. All assets connected within themselves. Generous transparent separation of at least 70px between neighboring asset silhouettes. No asset touches another, nothing cropped, no text, no grid.
Strict row-major order:
row 1 left: split seed with tiny emerging shoot; right: sprout with two LARGE broad cotyledons;
row 2 left: juvenile plant with FOUR large broad leaves and a readable short curved stem; right: budding/immature plant with FOUR large leaves and large species-specific closed buds/immature harvest parts;
row 3 left: mature plant with its full species-specific harvest parts and FOUR large supporting green leaves; right: harvested plant with FOUR large broad leaves and empty cut pedicels, no mature produce;
row 4 left: harvested botanical sprig/icon, large produce plus two broad leaves; right: warm paper seed packet with one large species emblem.
Art direction: polished hand-painted 2D farming-game inventory art, simplified solid color planes, strong readable shapes, saturated but natural emerald/teal foliage. Very clear dark forest-green leaf contours, dark plum/blue/umber contours on flowers/fruit. No pale halo, no white coating around leaves, no fuzz, no loose dots, no lace, no many tiny leaves, no filigree. Light faces and deep shadows form only two or three broad tone areas. Compact glints. Each leaf blade has a broad solid midsection and one pointed sweeping tip. Arrange leaves outward on separate gently curved branches, with a few clear air gaps; keep a lively asymmetrical silhouette, avoid a dense shapeless clump.
MATURE GEOMETRY: tall full plant about 1:2 width:height, THREE alternating harvest parts when the species calls for three. Each main harvest part has diameter/width 50-55% of the whole plant width, dramatically larger than in the edit target. Each supporting leaf spans 40-48% of the whole plant width with a broad face, not a thin strip. Attach produce at staggered heights and leaves on the opposite sides, with short visible stem segments. Flowers/fruit and leaves must remain substantial when the plant body reduces to approximately 12x26 pixels before adding a one-pixel dark outline. Keep the whole plant fully visible with margins. No soil, pot, ground shadow, characters, watermark or extra objects.
Glass Dewberry: THREE very large ROUND blue/cyan glass-marble BERRIES on the mature plant, staggered high-left / mid-right / low-left, rich cobalt shadow, one compact ivory shine each. FOUR large broad deep-teal supporting leaves, light turquoise-green faces, dark forest/blue-green edges. Budding stage: three large closed green calyces with emerging small blue berries. Harvest icon: TWO large round blue berries and two broad leaves. No flowers. Keep the berries round.
